thread:
Olivia: Quick sync — launch week newsletter cadence. TL;DR: three sends: pre-launch teaser, launch day, follow-up nurture. Need final segment defs & send windows. Ping @raj @emma

Raj: Agree. Can we split by product interest tags (benchmarks vs webinars) + intent (trial org vs lurkers)?

Emma: Yes. Proposed segments: A: High intent (trial > 1 action), B: Engaged but no trial, C: Cold. Also two regional windows (NA/APAC).

Mark: For APAC, move sends +8h from NA to hit mornings. Also recommend subject line variants A/B per segment.

Olivia: Can someone own sequencing? I can do copy for A/B for High intent. @linda can you handle automated reroutes for bounced contacts?

Linda: On it. Also will add a fallback to last-known-engagement campaign. Any suppression list updates?

Ben (ops-bot): Campaign draft created: campaign_id=camp_2026_launch_nurture. Preview URL: https://app.redwood.ai/campaigns/camp_2026_launch_nurture

Emma: Sending schedule (draft):
```
Day 0 - Teaser (A 09:00 NA / 17:00 APAC)
Day 2 - Launch email (A 09:00 NA / 17:00 APAC)
Day 5 - Nurture 1 (B 09:00 NA / 17:00 APAC)
Day 9 - Nurture 2 (C 09:00 NA / 17:00 APAC)
```

Raj: Segmentation rules (draft):
- High intent: tag:trial_user OR last_7d_actions>=2
- Engaged: opened_3+ OR clicked_benchmark
- Cold: rest - exclude unsubscribed/suppressed
We should exclude customers_on_dedicated.

Olivia: Love it. Quick QA: subject lines for High intent? I vote 'Get faster inference for your app — launch offer' vs 'Launch: optimize inference costs' — A/B to measure opens->trial.

Mark: :thumbsup: Also add UTM params: utm_campaign=launch_spring2026&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email

Emma: Can ops run a smoke test to the seed list 24h before first send? @ben

Ben (ops-bot): Smoke test scheduled for 1999992000 (24h prior). I'll post results in #marketing after runs.

Linda: Suppression checklist: unsubscribed, complaint_rate>0.1%, bounced_recent. I'll attach list to campaign.

Olivia: Great. Action items: Emma finalize schedule + subjects by EOD, Raj finalize seg rules + query, Linda suppression, Ben smoke test. I'll prepare copy for high intent. Sync tomorrow 10am PT. :coffee:
